_note: Knots (specs/FORYOU-TENSIONS.md): a fixed, generic vocabulary of the knots people bring to practice, each with the cues that find talks and practices that could RESOLVE it (a practice or teaching that works on it), ENLIGHTEN it (reframes it from the view: Trika's contraction and recognition, no-self, the witness) or EXPLAIN it (the mechanism, the text, the tradition's map). Hand-written by the curator; never derived from anyone's journal. app/tools/build-knots.mjs turns it into site/data/wisegraph/knots.json (ranked candidates per knot and role, with transcript moments as ids + timestamps only). `match` maps a journal tension to knots on the device (src/tensions.js). Why-lines are Satsang's own words: pointers, never promises. Regexes are case-insensitive JavaScript and are run on 'title | YouTube title | parent talk | gold why-line'.

grounding._note: When the journal shows distress (unsettled class), a block offers only these: gentle, eyes-open or body-based practices and talks on kindness and steadiness (spec AWAKENING-ALGORITHM §7.2).

intense._note: Never offered in gentle mode (soften/stop) or unsettled: holds, energy work, initiations, teacher-only practices.
